capabilities: create editable floating labels over a Markdown note
link labels to selected source text and toggle them with Ctrl/Cmd+click
drag and resize labels with document-space scroll synchronisation
style label background colour and transparency
store label content and geometry outside the note's Markdown body
extras: Not yet listed in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; manual installation via GitHub releases. The Editing Toolbar bridge is described as experimental and the README's screenshots are editable SVG placeholders pending real captures. A TESTING.md workflow is referenced for regression testing.
motivation: The author wanted contextual annotations for research, revision, planning and review work that sit next to an idea while leaving the note body untouched.
problem: Markdown notes are linear, so short contextual annotations cannot sit beside an idea without interrupting the document flow.

relations.evidence: This plugin includes an experimental bridge for Editing Toolbar.

summary: Floating Markdown annotation labels that can be moved, resized, linked to selected note text, and that scroll with the document.
